name: meta-ads-niche-report
description: Competitor ad research for media buyers: the Meta Ads Library (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok (Ad Library and Creative Center). The marketplace keeps its original name so existing install commands keep working.

plugins.name: meta-ads-niche-report
plugins.description: Collects and summarizes active competitor ads from the Meta Ads Library by niche and city.

plugins.name: tiktok-ads-niche-report
plugins.description: Collects and summarizes competitor ads from the TikTok Ad Library (EU/EEA, GB, CH, TR) and top ads from TikTok Creative Center (Ukraine, US and more) by niche and country.
